steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: I concede defeat, utterly and without reservation. Your strategy is impeccable: precise intelligence, meticulous preparation, and execution timed to perfection. It is truly an elegant and masterful victory. I knew from the start I never stood a chance.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: I must say, I'm rather pleased to have secured this much time.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: In light of recent events, the relevant authorities will be auditing Nirvana stock transactions. Additionally, details regarding the West District mine negotiations are being finalized and will be released shortly.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: This will not impede the mining development process. Moving forward, the new cabinet of DisCity will lead efforts to restart negotiations between Nirvana and the West District Executive Committee, ensuring cooperation is conducted with transparency, fairness, and active engagement.

steps.speaker: Gracelyn
steps.content: Hot damn! Hell yeah! I knew those bastards were up to no good!

steps.speaker: Harry
steps.content: Could it be Parfait... Haha, no way!
[Bureau]
As people around her react with shock or gleeful celebration, Elvira stands in the corner, watching the news.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: …Is it really over… just like this…?
Adelaide doesn't answer. Instead, from his pocket, he retrieves a pocket watch—delicate gold roses inlaid across its surface. With a deft flick, he opens it, his lips curving into a subtle smile.
15 minutes left.

The Mania barrier shielding him is fracturing, cracks spiderwebbing across its surface, creeping wider with every second. Yet Adelaide doesn't flinch—doesn't even glance up. He remains utterly detached from the chaos beyond, as if your words have lost all meaning.
He shifts to a topic he clearly favors, his words unfolding in a slow, leisurely rhythm. Yet beneath the calm, there's something unsettling in his voice.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Let me tell you more about my siblings.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: My family, the Campbells, has many children. For years now, my younger siblings have eyed one another with suspicion, fighting amongst themselves. It grieves me more than I can say.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: We are bound by blood, the closest of kin. In this lonely world, we have only each other to light the way. And yet... how did it come to this?

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: In time, I came to understand my father's design—he seeks the finest heir, and so he pits his children against one another, a crucible of survival. But when he dies... so too will these foolish rules. Love and peace will naturally reclaim their rightful place in the Campbell household.
The Underground cooperator glances at his pocket watch, as if counting down the seconds, unshaken by death, or perhaps...
Everything has been prepared. Even his death won't alter the outcome.
As the realization dawns on you, a chill runs down your spine.

steps.speaker: Option
options: ...Black Triangle, can you still receive orders?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Beep—

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Contact Paradeisos, EDGE, or that person who talked to me in your place... Codename 02, was it?

steps.speaker: Along the path to the castle, four souls tread, with lightness in their steps.
steps.content: Tell them something's wrong. Round up everyone from Fraser, no exceptions. Forget about diplomatic consequences. Do whatever it takes to get answers, and get them fast!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They've been planning this all along! The Great Expo, Aurum Secretum, Nirvana—none of it matters to them. Success or failure, those are never the real goal!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They've done something else behind our backs... Go now! Get answers!

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Buzz buzz buzz buzz—
After struggling for a moment, it emits a sound of failure.

steps.speaker: Option
options: If it won't work here, go outside!!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't worry about protecting me! Get out of the storm zone now! Find somewhere you can send a message. Tell EDGE there's something off with the Underground and Fraser!! The Great Expo is just a smokescreen they use to cover up something else. Hurry!
Schorl trembles briefly. It attempts to leave but returns to you. Against all reason, it activates its anti-Mania barrier, shielding you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't need your protection. You—
[Black Screen] 1.5s

EDGE Internal Meeting

In progress for 16 hours

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03</color>: The Mania Flux in the Outland territories are indeed abnormal. What's the Third Observatorium's conclusion? Still unable to confirm the cause of these fluctuations?
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07</color>: That's asking too much. The Observatorium can only accurately monitor fields near its own anchor points. Fraser's territory is too far away. Pinpointing the precise location is never possible, especially since we have no auxiliary observation points in the area.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03</color>: What about 04? Nirvana has been vouching for him. We should be getting information by now.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05</color>: He likely won't be able to attend. The securities market has collapsed, and Nirvana is in complete disarray.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05</color>: Also, I've heard an interesting piece of news, the same one that blew up Nirvana—
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-05</color>: An Outlander vagrant claims that Fraser has orchestrated its own Black Ring.
[Scene Change] Parfait's Helicopter
Parfait continues humming a cheerful tune to celebrate their victory, while Sibilla seems lost in thought.
At some point without her noticing, the protective charm that had safeguarded her journey broke. The colorful beads have all scattered, leaving only a grayish-white thread hanging from her wrist.
In the final three minutes, an elite FAC squad arrives at the MBCC Chief's side under emergency orders to provide protection.
Upon arrival, they still believe everything is already firmly under the Chief's control.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: We've done it! MBCC's Sinner has suppressed them!!
However, the most perceptive Sinner has already sensed something amiss.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...This feeling is... Aargh!!
Intense contamination suddenly erupts, distorting all her senses and plunging her into darkness in an instant.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: What happened?!! The Sinner is under some unknown influence. Containment is failing. Quick, move in and suppress the enemy!
Fortunately, this isn't Hecate's first encounter with such contamination—she can endure it. But unfortunately, she recognizes its source all too well.
It's the same vile resonance she felt at Keylan Square, from the High Tower Black Ring, and when Chief's shackles touched the depths of the abyss that should never have been disturbed.
But... ${PlayerName} is right in front of her, and he clearly hasn't touched anything...
steps.female_content: But... ${PlayerName} is right in front of her, and she clearly hasn't touched anything...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: No... this is not right... The contamination source isn't here, but somewhere far away... The enemy's goal, that man's target has always been...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hurry, protect Chief!!
[Scene Change]

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02</color>: No need to scan the entire area anymore. It's too difficult for the Observatorium and not accurate enough.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02</color>: Directly locate the observation points instead.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02</color>: Track all Sinners near Fraser whose positions are fixed by SHP-13's shackles. Their provocation of SHP-13 most likely serves this purpose.


<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: No need. It's already too late.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Change of strategy. There's only one priority now.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Retrieve SHP-13. Use whatever means necessary to bring him back. I'm counting on all of you.
steps.female_content:
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Change of strategy. There's only one priority now.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Retrieve SHP-13. Use whatever means necessary to bring her back. I'm counting on all of you.

steps.content: [Scene Change]
In the final minute, Adelaide's crimson barrier shatters at last. You want to strike—but your body refuses to obey.

You can no longer make out the black triangle or see your companions. Inside you, the shackles spill free in a torrent of unrestrained power. Despite being only steps away, even his face is lost to you now.
—Only his voice, infused with Mania, penetrates through your shackles, piercing deep into your soul.

steps.speaker: Adelaide?
steps.content: You must find this feeling unfamiliar, because you are strong. In the Outlands, I've seen too many people with fate's grip around their throats—way too many. I have grown accustomed to it.

steps.speaker: Adelaide?
steps.content: Don't grieve for Jasmine, nor rage against the people of Fraser. We are all brothers and sisters. Fate wraps its fingers around every throat equally—whether in the Outlands or DisCity, whether good or evil, whether you or I.

steps.speaker: Adelaide?
steps.content: Whether death has meaning is not for us to decide. Even if Fraser never stirred up hatred, those poor souls would still march one after another down the same path. Had you stood there yourself, you would understand—this is a path of sacrifice that cannot be diverted.

steps.speaker: Adelaide?
steps.content: Dear Shepherd, we cannot reclaim the past, nor can we halt the future. So we must find a way... to give meaning to all these inevitable sacrifices.

steps.speaker: Adelaide?
steps.content: We must change something for them, change the rules imposed by DisCity... and I propose we start with you. After all, you've already demonstrated your... unique value to DisCity.

steps.speaker: Adelaide?
steps.content: For the revolution to come, I'm afraid I must ask for your eternal silence.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Sacrifice...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What do you mean...?

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Ah, by the way, my sister's new friend is a Sinner from MBCC. You must be acquainted with her, I presume? Hypa invited her to visit Fraser, and they were likely going to celebrate a birthday together. Regrettably, my DisCity business trip coincides perfectly to make me miss the occasion.

options: Tell me straight! What have you sacrificed?!!

steps.content: [Release the shackles] Are there dark shackles?
The moment the shackles release, the spikes piercing through your body are pitch-black, brimming with contamination instead. But you're beyond caring now.
You must catch him! No matter where he runs, you must catch him!
The spikes slash across Adelaide's cheek, but he neither dodges nor wipes away the blood. He only watches you, his gaze a twisted mix of admiration and pity.
The Mania flower in his hand gradually dims, yet still possesses enough power to slowly coalesce into a massive shadow. The shadow bows before him, inviting him to step onto it.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Regardless, you have always been my purpose for coming here. Even my pursuit of this Great Expo was for you.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Thank you for being so vigilant, brave, and righteous. When you decided to personally come and "punish" me, my purpose was already served.
Adelaide bows to you as the shadow envelops him, while another hand reaches out toward you...
...only to be pierced by the spikes of the shackles. The monster lets out an agonizing roar as it leaps upward, soaring into the sky.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!!
With every ounce of strength you have left, you use the shackles to anchor yourself to the monster taking off.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...You're not getting away!
0 second left

<size=80><color=#fb9259>BR-005 OUTBREAK
Time: June 25, N.F. 115
Location: UNKNOWN
Scale: UNKNOWN
Ground Zero: UNKNOWN</size></color>

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: ...Hey, wake up. Why the long face again?
Through the haze, a voice cuts clearly through to your ears. You struggle to open your eyes—
High in the sky, amid howling winds and swirling sands, you first glimpse a figure clad in red—then, an enormous military vehicle soaring through the air.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...It's you...
You recognize this vehicle. There's a gash in the roof—Jasmine's handiwork.
This is the Commander-in-Chief's vehicle from the closing ceremony...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Who... are you really...

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: I'm an arms dealer. Naturally, I go wherever there's war.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: You look like hell though. Did someone turn you into a war trophy? Go ahead—pick your poison. Fraser? Or me?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: War trophy...?
The murderous impulse that once contaminated your mind stirs once more.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You've got to be kidding... I'm going to find them. All of them. Everyone involved in this...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll kill them all!!
She watches you, and slowly, a smile spreads across her face.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: This state suits you well.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: So... time for war!
She draws her blade from her side, and then...
[Dragon Slaying CG]

It's a ferocious battle. Dozens of steel rods skewer the monstrous foe as it thrashes and roars. Nearby, FAC reinforcements clash against an unnatural sandstorm, one that erupted without warning in WhiteSands. In the near future, this would be remembered as the opening salvo of that great war.
But despite being closest to it all, you can no longer hear or see clearly.
[Dragon Slaying CG] 1s darken and turn yellow
You slide off the massive creature's back, falling, until another dragon catches you.
It seems too weak to bear your weight, plummeting down with you. In your daze, a muffled cry reaches you, and instinctively reach out to shield her.
You struggle forward, through the storm, through the slow, relentless tide of Apostles—toward the end of the shackles, the end of filth, hatred, and chaos...
You only want to grasp one voice, one silhouette.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey dummy, just wait for me, alright?
